findings.title: Removing `findMany` breaks the service query API
findings.body: This replaces the public `findMany` method, which accepted Prisma query arguments and returned booking rows, with `getBaseConditions`, which only returns a SQL fragment. Existing callers of `InsightsBookingService.findMany(...)` will no longer compile, and there is no equivalent method here to execute their queries. Migrate all callers in this change or preserve a compatible query method.
